about: Arm C's trial (the user, 2026-11-20): for each daemon arm C redrew (engine a01ea9d67), keep the new art or revert to the old. Seen in the DEBUG build: DEBUG -> GAME EVENTS -> ART C: OLD / NEW (A swaps old/new, B next, SELECT back, START out). verdict: pending | keep | revert; parts: which of front/back/icon the verdict covers (default: everything arm C redrew); note: free text. The old art is in engineGba graphics/daemons_armc_old/<folder>/ (front.png, back.png, icon.png, normal.pal, from a01ea9d67^), with its old y_offsets and icon palette in src/data/daemons_debug_artc.h. A later script applies a revert; nothing reads this file yet.
